errors.evidence: The description states that the 'Consistency-CE' line has a solid line style, but both the legend and the line itself in the plot are dashed.
The starting point of the 'Consistency-CE' line is at an Average Lagging (AL) value of approximately 2.2, not 2.5.
The ending point of the 'Consistency-CE' line is at an Average Lagging (AL) value of approximately 10.5, not 10.0.

The starting point of the 'Inconsistency-CE' line is at an Average Lagging (AL) value of approximately 2.2, not 2.5.
The ending point of the 'Inconsistency-CE' line is at an Average Lagging (AL) value of approximately 8.5, not 10.0.
